benchmark: procedural regression suite, not a public robotics leaderboard
input: oracle object poses and static obstacles

calibration.cause_of_six_failures: MuJoCo QACC numerical instability with 5 ms timestep
calibration.fix: 2 ms physics timestep plus fail-closed detection of numerical resets

evaluation.note: Held-out seeds vary table position within a narrow 24 cm range; this is not broad generalization.

limitations: Ideal planar velocity-actuated base; wheel slip is not modeled
Single small rigid block and tuned contact parameters
Static obstacles, perfect localization and object identities
Not a perception, SLAM, physical hardware or model fine-tuning result
reproduce: uv run --project be --group sim python -m htn_backend.simulation.evaluate
